profiles.display_name: Reference Baseline With Advective Challenge Review

review_checklist.prompt: Confirm the governed selection review status is recorded and still supports the baseline-versus-challenge path being presented to assessors.
review_checklist.rationale: The composed challenge review is only meaningful if the underlying governed selection review remains traceable and reviewable.

review_checklist.prompt: Confirm the governed comparison review status and dominant deltas are recorded when the selection path recommends an experimental challenge family.
review_checklist.rationale: Assessors need to see whether the optional comparison path is present, ready, and materially informative before treating the challenge family as decision-relevant.

review_checklist.prompt: Review whether the primary and challenge applicability lines are preserved on the composed challenge review artifact.
review_checklist.rationale: The challenge review should remain explicit about the baseline family scope and the experimental-family scope rather than collapsing them into one status.

profiles.review_packet_template: Build a governed assessor-facing composed challenge review packet that bundles the selection review path and, when triggered, the reference-versus-advective comparison review path without losing baseline-versus-experimental framing.
profiles.review_brief_template: Summarize whether the governed model-family challenge review is ready for assessor-facing reuse, preserving selection status, comparison status, dominant deltas, and applicability context.
profiles.ready_action_template: Composed model-family challenge review is ready for assessor-facing use because the governed selection review is ready and any required comparison review is also ready.
profiles.attention_action_template: Keep the composed model-family challenge review in assessor-facing attention status until the governed selection-review or comparison-review concerns are resolved.
review_notes: Use this profile when the reference family remains the baseline and the advective family is carried as a governed challenge path.
Preserve baseline-versus-experimental framing even when the comparison review is ready.
Do not present the challenge family without either a ready comparison review or an explicit baseline-only selection path.
profiles.applicability_note: This challenge review profile is intended for the composed reference-baseline and advective-challenge assessor workflow inside Fate MCP's concentration-only boundary.
